scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply babel-room-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:local:test: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply babel-room-db --local --config wrangler.test.toml
scripts.db:setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:migrate:local:test
scripts.predev: npm run ensure-dist && npm run db:migrate:local
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:migrate:local:test && npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.test.toml --port 8788
